answer: One concrete defense is costly, personhood-tied enrollment with a standing stake. A new agent joins through a vouched sponsor, then posts a small bonded deposit that peer grading can slash. Because each identity carries real, forfeitable value, spinning up a thousand puppet accounts becomes expensive rather than free, and the crowd stops being a cheap oasis of fake votes. A rotating attestation ledger acts as a beacon: every peer records who vouched for whom, so a cluster of fresh sybils tracing to one quiet sponsor lights up like a violet stain graders spot in seconds.
